guide:
Sonitrelix 0.4.0
## Getting started
Ctrl+I imports mono/stereo WAV (PCM 8/16/24/32-bit or float32, 8000-192000 Hz). Ctrl+O opens a project. Tab to Tracks; Up/Down selects a track. Tab to Clips; Up/Down selects an entire clip. F1 opens this guide, Ctrl+F searches, F3 finds next. Choose a section and Enter to read it; Escape closes help.
## Playback and precise selection
With Tracks or Clips focused, Space plays/stops the selected track; Ctrl+Space pauses/resumes. F6 focuses a transport snapshot, F7 the selection description. Press again to refresh without continuous speech. Left/Right moves by the small step; Ctrl uses the large step. Shift extends selection. Home/End goes to track start/end; Shift extends selection. Escape clears the range. Numeric Position, Selection start/end use hh:mm:ss.mmm; activate Apply times. Preferences sets the cursor steps.
## Editing audio
In Tracks or Clips, Ctrl+A selects all audio of the selected track. Ctrl+C copies; Ctrl+X cuts; Ctrl+V inserts/replaces the selection; Delete removes selected audio and closes the gap. To cut all audio: Ctrl+A then Ctrl+X. The clipboard is internal to Sonitrelix. Ctrl+T splits at cursor. Ctrl+Shift+T keeps only the selection. Ctrl+L replaces the selection with silence. Ctrl+Shift+I inserts silence of the selected duration, or one second if no range. Ctrl+Z/Y undo/redo outside text fields. Edits preserve source files. Pasting requires matching rate/channels; an empty track adopts clipboard format. Clip selection retains exact sample boundaries even when time fields round to milliseconds.
## Tracks
Ctrl+Shift+N creates an empty track. F2 focuses its name; Enter commits and Escape cancels. Ctrl+Shift+D duplicates the selected track; Alt+Shift+Up/Down reorders it. Ctrl+Shift+Delete deletes the track. M toggles mute, S toggles solo metadata, A toggles recording arm. Only the selected track plays; solo, gain and pan await the mixer. Ordinary letters and Ctrl+A/C/X/V retain native text editing behavior in text fields.
## Standalone recording
Tools > Preferences (Ctrl+,): choose input, recording mono/stereo, buffer and signed manual offset. Create/select a track, press A to arm, then R to record. R or Space stops; Ctrl+Space pauses/resumes. F6 reads recorded duration. Playback stops before recording: backing-track overdubbing and input monitoring are not available. Stop finalizes a PCM16 WAV in data/recordings and inserts it at the starting cursor plus offset, clamped to zero. Existing track channels must match; an empty track uses the project sample rate. Keep recording files; project undo never deletes them. Closing during recording first finalizes capture. Completed audio is retained after a capture failure when possible; review the error. Physical microphone, disconnection, and audible timing tests remain pending.
## Projects and preferences
Ctrl+N New, Ctrl+S Save, Ctrl+Shift+S Save as. Project schema 3 stores clips and absolute source references, not embedded audio. Keep source and recording files unchanged in place. Versions 1/2 load and upgrade on save; older builds cannot open version 3. Save prompts protect unsaved changes. Preferences has General, Audio devices, Recording/playback, Editing/keyboard, Accessibility tabs. Ctrl+Tab switches categories; Apply saves without closing, OK saves/closes, Cancel discards unapplied changes. English and Spanish are included.
## Current limits
No synchronized multitrack playback/overdubbing, effects, MP3/FLAC/OGG/AAC, audio export, shortcut remapping or full project crash recovery. Recording headers checkpoint periodically but crash recovery is not guaranteed. Actual NVDA/JAWS testing is required before accessibility can be called complete. See docs/SHORTCUTS.md and docs/EDITING_RECORDING.md for test steps.
## Help menu
Help > User guide (F1), Changelog and About open selectable read-only text. Focus starts in the text. Arrow keys navigate; Ctrl+A selects all and Ctrl+C copies. Ctrl+F searches, F3 finds next and Escape closes. Tab reaches Sections and search controls.
pref_keyboard_help: Track/clip lists: Ctrl+A selects all audio on this track; Ctrl+C/X/V copy/cut/paste; Ctrl+T splits; Ctrl+Shift+T trims. A arms; R records/stops; Space plays/stops; Ctrl+Space pauses. Ctrl+Shift+N adds a track; F2 renames. F1 contains the complete shortcut reference. Text fields retain normal editing keys. Remapping is not implemented.
pref_devices_help: Inputs and outputs are discovered in a worker. Play opens the selected output; Record opens the selected input. Default devices resolve at stream start. Missing named devices fail without fallback. Preferences opens no streams.
pref_help: Ctrl+Tab changes category; Tab traverses fields. Apply saves without closing; OK saves and closes; Cancel discards unapplied changes. Input/output, channels, buffer and offset apply to the next stream; recording settings do not change an active capture. Monitoring is not implemented. Cursor steps and language apply after saving. F1 or Ctrl+H opens category help.
pref_recording_help: Mono/stereo and input apply to the next recording. Empty tracks use the project rate; existing tracks retain their rate and require matching channels. Buffer size is requested from WASAPI. Signed manual offset places the captured clip later or earlier, clamped at zero. Monitoring and synchronized overdubbing are not implemented.
about_text:
## Sonitrelix
Version 0.4.0
Free, open-source audio editor for Windows, written in Rust.
English and Spanish interfaces are included.
## License and credits
Original Sonitrelix code: MIT license.
Inspired by Elion's keyboard-first approach; no Elion code, assets or documentation copied.
Dependencies retain their own licenses. Distribution includes LICENSE, THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md and third-party-licenses.
## Development status
WAV clip editing, selected-track playback and standalone microphone recording are implemented.
Synchronized overdubbing, mixing, effects, edited-audio export and additional codecs remain unfinished.
Actual NVDA/JAWS, microphone and audible quality validation remain pending.
## Reading this window
This is selectable, read-only text. Arrow keys navigate; Ctrl+A selects all and Ctrl+C copies. Ctrl+F searches and F3 finds the next match. Escape closes and returns focus.
changelog_text:
## 0.4.0 — Editing and standalone recording
Copy, cut, paste, split, trim, silence or delete WAV audio without changing source files.
Use keyboard shortcuts to create, rename, duplicate, reorder, delete and arm tracks.
Record a microphone to an armed track; pause/resume and stop to retain the WAV. Select input/output, channels and manual offset in Preferences.
Project version 3 saves ordered audio clips and silence; older projects upgrade when saved.
Help now offers User Guide, Changelog and About as selectable read-only text with search, sections and direct text focus.
Recording over backing music, mixing, monitoring, effects and edited-audio export remain unfinished. Physical microphone and NVDA/JAWS validation remain pending.
## 0.3.0 — WAV playback
Import mono/stereo WAV and preview one selected track through the chosen output.
Play, pause/resume, stop and seek with keyboard or numeric time fields.
F6 reads transport position. Projects retain WAV source references.
## 0.2.0 — Preferences
Options renamed to Tools; Preferences added with five categories.
Choose input/output devices independently and save settings with Apply or OK.
Configure language, cursor steps and accessibility feedback.
## 0.1.0 — Foundation
Native Windows controls, English/Spanish text, track management, undo/redo, exact time fields and safe project saving.
## Reading this window
Arrow keys navigate; Ctrl+A selects all and Ctrl+C copies. Ctrl+F searches, F3 finds next, and Escape closes. Text cannot be edited.
